newsitem.title: MALTA: FORECAST - Malta growth slowing to 3-4 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Malta growth slowing to 3-4 pct.

text.p: Malta's economy is expected to grow between three and four percent this year, with the government deficit reaching seven percent, Maltese Central Bank Governor Francis Vassallo said in remarks published on Tuesday.

The economy grew just over six percent last year and Vassallo told In-Nazzjon newspaper the slowdown was natural in view of the change of government last October and uncertainty about proposed changes to the tax structure.
The new Labour government was elected on a promise to repeal Value Added Tax, and is suggesting instead a system of customs duties, excise, and a tax on products and services.
Vassallo said the Central Bank was carrying out an internal exercise to establish whether the proposed new taxation system would result in more or less revenue to the government.
